entities.name: MCCH information acquisition procedure
entities.description: Procedure applied by UE to acquire MCCH information for receiving MBS broadcast services.

entities.name: UE interested to receive MBS broadcast services
entities.description: Condition where UE becomes interested in receiving MBS broadcast services.

entities.name: UE entering cell providing SIB20
entities.description: Condition triggered by UE mobility events like power on or cell change.

entities.name: Notification of MCCH information change due to new MBS service start
entities.description: Notification received by UE indicating MCCH information changed due to new MBS service initiation.

entities.name: UE receiving data via broadcast MRB
entities.description: Condition where UE is actively receiving data through broadcast Multicast Radio Bearer.

entities.name: Notification of MCCH information modification
entities.description: Notification received by UE indicating MCCH information changed due to modifications other than new MBS session start.

entities.name: Overwrite stored MCCH information
entities.description: Property where MCCH information acquisition procedure overwrites any previously stored MCCH information without delta configuration.

entities.name: Discontinue using absent field
entities.description: Property where UE discontinues using a field if it is absent in the newly acquired MCCH information.

relations.description: UE applies MCCH information acquisition procedure when becoming interested in MBS broadcast services.
UE applies MCCH information acquisition procedure upon entering a cell providing SIB20.
UE applies MCCH information acquisition procedure upon notification of MCCH change due to new MBS service start.
UE receiving broadcast MRB applies MCCH information acquisition procedure upon MCCH change notification.
UE applies MCCH information acquisition procedure upon notification of MCCH modification other than new session start.
MCCH information acquisition procedure overwrites stored MCCH information without delta configuration.
UE discontinues using a field if it is absent in the acquired MCCH information.
